digest.component_or_area: janitor plan review gate (RP-02 through RP-06 derisk approval)
propositions: Recovered RP-02-RP-06 approval decisions contain approved-but-lossy definitions that require evidence-backed research and maintainer confirmation before implementation stories are created

RP-02 BindingStore requires ordered exact-match retirement recovery where durable tombstone, forward, and reverse identities must exactly match to advance grace; repeat is a no-op; ambiguity safely aborts

RP-03 outbound Jira lifecycle must enforce scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted logical outcomes across >=2 tickets) with maximum 3 physical invocations, 15 seconds cumulative sleep, and explicit commit_unknown for writes with lost responses
RP-04 operation snapshot composition requires explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default precedence, per-operation configuration snapshot, and fail-closed behavior on malformed config

RP-05 CLI registry must normalize all 21 visible advanced verbs onto side-effect-free package-data help, support both canonical and accepted-alias help routing before RP-04 snapshot composition, and enumerate exact/compatibility/hidden spellings with typed discovery

RP-06 plan-review gate must enforce effective applicability policy (non-empty repository-relative globs for project LLM criteria), fail-open only on bounded RP-01 recovery, record typed per-unit discovery trace for retry, and support explicit review-plan --retry only for latest INDETERMINATE reviews with retryable missing calls
